note: Regional park about 8 km southwest of Riverhurst on the east shore of Lake Diefenbaker, with two campgrounds about 3 km apart: the main park (north campground, beside the swimming beach, pool and golf course) and Rusty's Coulee Marina (south campground, larger full-hookup sites by the marina). Mostly seasonal: about 81 of its roughly 300 sites are sold by the night, about 14 of them at the marina. Electric sites have 220-volt plug-ins; a 110 plug needs an adaptor. --Claude

The rows nearest the beach on the north campground map (Edgewater Drive 401-425, Edgewater 1-17 and Beachfront Drive 1-24, around 50.8872,-106.9570) are not among Let's Camp's 81 nightly sites, so they are seasonal; imagery also shows a 40-70 m shrub/tree strip and a low bank between them and the beach.
